title: Halcyon — Sleep sounds, stories, and a gentle timer
description: Mix sleep sounds with individual volume controls, save a favorite blend, and fade it out with a timer. Explore breathing exercises, guides, and sleep stories.
headline:
A little sound.
A softer evening.
intro: Mix rain, a fan, or a low wash of noise to suit the room. Set a fade-out timer, settle into a story, or follow a breathing exercise. Halcyon leaves the evening yours.
tagline: Make a mix, set a timer, let the day quiet down.
cardHeadline: Mix your own sleep sounds, settle into a story, and let a timer fade things out.
purchaseNote: Halcyon Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. The annual plan offers a 7-day free trial, subject to eligibility. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or subscription ends to avoid renewal; manage it in your App Store account settings.

steps.title: Choose your layers
steps.text: Select available sounds and set the volume of each one. Free mixes can hold up to three layers; Premium opens the complete 39-sound library with unlimited layers.

steps.title: Choose how the evening ends
steps.text: Set a timer that fades the mix to silence, or try a wind-down program. Save a timer with a mix or set a default for when you press play.

steps.title: Return to something familiar
steps.text: Save up to two mixes for free. Keep sounds playing with the screen locked, or take a quiet moment with breathing exercises, an available guide, or a story.

features.title: A mix with room to adjust
features.text: Nature, water, noise, comfort, ambience, pulses, and binaural tones make up the full library. Adjust individual sound levels instead of accepting one fixed recording.

features.title: More than a sound loop
features.text: The full collection includes 10 guides, 20 original stories, and three wind-down programs. Eighteen stories have narration in four voices; The Riverboat includes all four voices without Premium.

features.title: Playback that fits your evening
features.text: Use background playback, Siri Shortcuts, and optional playback alongside another app. When alongside playback is enabled, Halcyon turns off its Lock Screen controls.

included: Available free sounds, up to 3 layers, and 2 saved mixes
Fade-out sleep timer and background playback
Breathing exercises and a free selection of guides and stories
The Riverboat narration in all four voices; file backup and restore
premium: All 39 sounds, unlimited mix layers, and unlimited saved mixes
All 10 guides and 20 stories; four read-aloud voices for narrated stories beyond The Riverboat
Deep Descent and Long Night wind-down programs
Adaptive soundscapes across the whole library
privacy: Mixes, favorites, and settings can be backed up to a file you save or share yourself.
Purchases and entitlement checks use Apple and RevenueCat. App updates use Expo; local activity storage does not mean the app never connects to the internet.
A file backup is a manual action, not a promise of automatic cloud sync.
limitations: Halcyon is for general relaxation and everyday wind-down, not diagnosis or treatment for insomnia or any other condition. Sleep and focus outcomes are not guaranteed.
Not every story has narration: the released version has 18 narrated stories out of 20. Headphones are recommended for binaural tones, not required for ordinary sound mixes.
Use a comfortable listening volume. Optional alongside playback changes which app provides Lock Screen controls.
